'''Alex Davis''' (Japanese: '''ノボル''' ''Noboru'') is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP171|Power Play!]]''.

Announcing himself as "Alex Davis from [[Cherrygrove City]]", he challenged [[Gary Oak]] to a {{pkmn|battle}} using his {{p|Alakazam}}. However, Gary was able to defeat Alex without much trouble. {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}}, who just walked nearby, saw the battle, leading to another encounter between Ash and his rival.
{{-}}
